description: GenAI cost and usage, agent sessions, MCP tool usage and Continuous Queries alerts from the BigQuery exporter's companion views.

panels.title: LLM calls

targets.rawSql:
SELECT SUM(call_count) AS llm_calls
FROM `${VAR_PROJECT}.${VAR_DATASET}.v_gen_ai_model_costs`
WHERE $__timeFilter(usage_hour)
  AND ('__all' IN UNNEST(ARRAY<STRING>${service:json}) OR COALESCE(service_name, '(none)') IN UNNEST(ARRAY<STRING>${service:json}))

panels.description: Inference calls in the range, from v_gen_ai_model_costs.

panels.title: Error rate

targets.rawSql:
SELECT SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(error_count), SUM(call_count)) AS error_rate
FROM `${VAR_PROJECT}.${VAR_DATASET}.v_gen_ai_model_costs`
WHERE $__timeFilter(usage_hour)
  AND ('__all' IN UNNEST(ARRAY<STRING>${service:json}) OR COALESCE(service_name, '(none)') IN UNNEST(ARRAY<STRING>${service:json}))

panels.description: Errored LLM calls over all LLM calls.

panels.title: Tokens

  SUM(total_output_tokens) AS output,
  SUM(total_reasoning_tokens) AS reasoning,

  SUM(total_cache_creation_input_tokens) AS cache_creation
FROM `${VAR_PROJECT}.${VAR_DATASET}.v_gen_ai_model_costs`
WHERE $__timeFilter(usage_hour)
  AND ('__all' IN UNNEST(ARRAY<STRING>${service:json}) OR COALESCE(service_name, '(none)') IN UNNEST(ARRAY<STRING>${service:json}))

panels.description: Token totals by kind. The view counts each token once.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  usage_hour AS time,
  SUM(total_input_tokens) AS input,
  SUM(total_output_tokens) AS output,
  SUM(total_reasoning_tokens) AS reasoning,
  SUM(total_cache_read_input_tokens) AS cache_read,
  SUM(total_cache_creation_input_tokens) AS cache_creation
FROM `${VAR_PROJECT}.${VAR_DATASET}.v_gen_ai_model_costs`
WHERE $__timeFilter(usage_hour)
  AND ('__all' IN UNNEST(ARRAY<STRING>${service:json}) OR COALESCE(service_name, '(none)') IN UNNEST(ARRAY<STRING>${service:json}))
GROUP BY usage_hour
ORDER BY usage_hour

panels.title: Worst p95 latency by model and hour

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  usage_hour AS time,
  COALESCE(model, '(unknown)') AS model,
  MAX(p95_duration_ms) AS p95_ms
FROM `${VAR_PROJECT}.${VAR_DATASET}.v_gen_ai_model_costs`
WHERE $__timeFilter(usage_hour)
  AND ('__all' IN UNNEST(ARRAY<STRING>${service:json}) OR COALESCE(service_name, '(none)') IN UNNEST(ARRAY<STRING>${service:json}))
GROUP BY usage_hour, model
ORDER BY usage_hour

panels.description: The view holds p95 per hour and model. Percentiles cannot be averaged, so the series is the per-hour value.

panels.title: Tokens by model

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  COALESCE(model, '(unknown)') AS model,
  SUM(total_input_tokens) AS input,
  SUM(total_output_tokens) AS output
FROM `${VAR_PROJECT}.${VAR_DATASET}.v_gen_ai_model_costs`
WHERE $__timeFilter(usage_hour)

panels.description: Input and output tokens of the 15 models with the most input tokens.

panels.title: Top error types

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  COALESCE(e.value, '(none)') AS error_type,
  SUM(e.count) AS errors
FROM `${VAR_PROJECT}.${VAR_DATASET}.v_gen_ai_model_costs`, UNNEST(top_error_types) AS e

panels.title: Model ledger

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  provider,
  model,
  SUM(call_count) AS calls,
  SUM(error_count) AS errors,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(error_count), SUM(call_count)) AS error_rate,
  SUM(total_input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
  SUM(total_output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
  SUM(total_reasoning_tokens) AS reasoning_tokens,
  SUM(total_cache_read_input_tokens) AS cache_read_tokens,
  SUM(total_cache_creation_input_tokens) AS cache_creation_tokens,
  MAX(p50_duration_ms) AS worst_p50_ms,
  MAX(p95_duration_ms) AS worst_p95_ms,
  MAX(p99_duration_ms) AS worst_p99_ms
FROM `${VAR_PROJECT}.${VAR_DATASET}.v_gen_ai_model_costs`
WHERE $__timeFilter(usage_hour)
  AND ('__all' IN UNNEST(ARRAY<STRING>${service:json}) OR COALESCE(service_name, '(none)') IN UNNEST(ARRAY<STRING>${service:json}))
GROUP BY provider, model
ORDER BY calls DESC
LIMIT 50

panels.description: Latency columns are the worst hourly percentile in the range.

panels.title: Sessions and active users

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS sessions,
  COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS active_users
FROM `${VAR_PROJECT}.${VAR_DATASET}.v_gen_ai_sessions`
WHERE session_start_date >= DATE(TIMESTAMP_MILLIS(${__from}))
  AND session_start_date <= DATE(TIMESTAMP_MILLIS(${__to}))
  AND ('__all' IN UNNEST(ARRAY<STRING>${service:json}) OR COALESCE(service_name, '(none)') IN UNNEST(ARRAY<STRING>${service:json}))

panels.description: Distinct sessions and distinct user_id values. A session that crosses midnight UTC has a row on each date but counts once.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  AVG(turn_count) AS avg_turns,
  AVG(session_duration_ms) AS avg_duration_ms
FROM `${VAR_PROJECT}.${VAR_DATASET}.v_gen_ai_sessions`
WHERE session_start_date >= DATE(TIMESTAMP_MILLIS(${__from}))
  AND session_start_date <= DATE(TIMESTAMP_MILLIS(${__to}))
  AND ('__all' IN UNNEST(ARRAY<STRING>${service:json}) OR COALESCE(service_name, '(none)') IN UNNEST(ARRAY<STRING>${service:json}))

panels.title: Sessions and active users by day

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  TIMESTAMP(session_start_date) AS time,
  COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS sessions,
  COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS active_users
FROM `${VAR_PROJECT}.${VAR_DATASET}.v_gen_ai_sessions`
WHERE session_start_date >= DATE(TIMESTAMP_MILLIS(${__from}))
  AND session_start_date <= DATE(TIMESTAMP_MILLIS(${__to}))
  AND ('__all' IN UNNEST(ARRAY<STRING>${service:json}) OR COALESCE(service_name, '(none)') IN UNNEST(ARRAY<STRING>${service:json}))
GROUP BY session_start_date
ORDER BY session_start_date

panels.title: Turns per session

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN turn_count <= 1 THEN '01'
    WHEN turn_count <= 3 THEN '02-03'
    WHEN turn_count <= 6 THEN '04-06'
    WHEN turn_count <= 10 THEN '07-10'
    ELSE '11+'
  END AS turns,
  COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS sessions
FROM `${VAR_PROJECT}.${VAR_DATASET}.v_gen_ai_sessions`
WHERE session_start_date >= DATE(TIMESTAMP_MILLIS(${__from}))
  AND session_start_date <= DATE(TIMESTAMP_MILLIS(${__to}))
  AND ('__all' IN UNNEST(ARRAY<STRING>${service:json}) OR COALESCE(service_name, '(none)') IN UNNEST(ARRAY<STRING>${service:json}))
GROUP BY turns
ORDER BY turns

panels.description: Distribution of sessions by number of turns.

panels.title: Agent activity per session by day

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  TIMESTAMP(session_start_date) AS time,
  AVG(invocation_count) AS invocations,
  AVG(agent_invocation_count) AS agent_invocations,
  AVG(llm_call_count) AS llm_calls,
  AVG(tool_call_count) AS tool_calls
FROM `${VAR_PROJECT}.${VAR_DATASET}.v_gen_ai_sessions`
WHERE session_start_date >= DATE(TIMESTAMP_MILLIS(${__from}))
  AND session_start_date <= DATE(TIMESTAMP_MILLIS(${__to}))
  AND ('__all' IN UNNEST(ARRAY<STRING>${service:json}) OR COALESCE(service_name, '(none)') IN UNNEST(ARRAY<STRING>${service:json}))
GROUP BY session_start_date
ORDER BY session_start_date

panels.description: Average invocations, agent invocations, LLM calls and tool calls of a session, by session start date.

panels.title: Session error ledger

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  session_start_time AS time,
  session_id,
  user_id,
  service_name,
  agent_name,
  error_count,
  typed_error_count,
  turn_count,
  llm_call_count,
  tool_call_count,
  session_duration_ms,
  NULLIF(
    ARRAY_TO_STRING(
      ARRAY(
        SELECT CONCAT(COALESCE(e.value, ''), ' (', CAST(e.count AS STRING), ')')
        FROM UNNEST(top_error_types) AS e
      ),
      ', '
    ),
    ''
  ) AS top_error_types
FROM `${VAR_PROJECT}.${VAR_DATASET}.v_gen_ai_sessions`
WHERE session_start_date >= DATE(TIMESTAMP_MILLIS(${__from}))
  AND session_start_date <= DATE(TIMESTAMP_MILLIS(${__to}))
  AND ('__all' IN UNNEST(ARRAY<STRING>${service:json}) OR COALESCE(service_name, '(none)') IN UNNEST(ARRAY<STRING>${service:json}))
  AND error_count > 0
ORDER BY error_count DESC
LIMIT 100

panels.description: Sessions with at least one errored span, most errors first.

panels.title: MCP calls

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  SUM(call_count) AS mcp_calls,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(error_count), SUM(call_count)) AS error_rate,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(gen_ai_tagged_call_count), SUM(call_count)) AS also_genai_tagged
FROM `${VAR_PROJECT}.${VAR_DATASET}.v_mcp_tool_usage`
WHERE $__timeFilter(usage_hour)
  AND ('__all' IN UNNEST(ARRAY<STRING>${service:json}) OR COALESCE(service_name, '(none)') IN UNNEST(ARRAY<STRING>${service:json}))

panels.description: MCP calls, the share that errored, and the share that is also tagged as a GenAI tool call (gen_ai_tagged_call_count).

panels.title: MCP calls by JSON-RPC method

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  COALESCE(mcp_method_name, '(none)') AS method,

FROM `${VAR_PROJECT}.${VAR_DATASET}.v_mcp_tool_usage`

panels.title: Alerts

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT alert_id) AS alerts
FROM `${VAR_PROJECT}.${VAR_DATASET}.otel_alerts`
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
  AND ('__all' IN UNNEST(ARRAY<STRING>${service:json}) OR COALESCE(service_name, '(none)') IN UNNEST(ARRAY<STRING>${service:json}))

panels.description: Distinct alerts. Needs the otel_alerts table (Terraform enable_continuous_queries). Alerts are delivered at least once, so each alert_id counts once.

panels.title: Alert volume by hour and kind

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(event_time, HOUR) AS time,
  alert_kind,
  COUNT(DISTINCT alert_id) AS alerts
FROM `${VAR_PROJECT}.${VAR_DATASET}.otel_alerts`
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
  AND ('__all' IN UNNEST(ARRAY<STRING>${service:json}) OR COALESCE(service_name, '(none)') IN UNNEST(ARRAY<STRING>${service:json}))
GROUP BY time, alert_kind
ORDER BY time

panels.description: TOOL_ERROR, TOKEN_BUDGET_BURN, AGENT_LATENCY_HIGH and the optional TOOL_ERROR_WINDOW.

panels.title: Alert log

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  event_time AS time,
  alert_kind,
  service_name,
  NULLIF(trace_id, '') AS trace_id,
  JSON_VALUE(payload, '$.agent_name') AS agent_name,
  JSON_VALUE(payload, '$.tool_name') AS tool_name,
  JSON_VALUE(payload, '$.error_type') AS error_type
FROM `${VAR_PROJECT}.${VAR_DATASET}.otel_alerts`
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
  AND ('__all' IN UNNEST(ARRAY<STRING>${service:json}) OR COALESCE(service_name, '(none)') IN UNNEST(ARRAY<STRING>${service:json}))
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY alert_id ORDER BY event_time ASC) = 1
ORDER BY event_time DESC
LIMIT 100

panels.description: Newest alerts first, one row per alert_id. The trace_id link opens Cloud Trace Explorer when the same traces are exported to Cloud Trace.
